title: Washed Clean Like Warm Water
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sometimes we do a thing that's wrong,
Our hearts feel yucky, sad,
A gentle song says, 'Lord, please give
A clean heart, make me glad.'

[Chorus]
When you say sorry, God will wash
Your heart all clean and new,
Like water washing off the mud,
He always forgives you.

[Verse 2]
We say we're sorry, try again,
And God gives a fresh start,
The yucky feeling floats away,
He gives a clean, new heart.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, and if today
You made a small mistake,
Just whisper sorry; God forgives,
Clean heart when you awake.

[Chorus]
mood: Washing music. A soft, flowing sway like warm water moving back and forth in a basin, gentle and forgiving, matching a story about a heart made clean. The pulse never scolds; it stays kind and even under the sorry and the fresh start. By the last verse it slows and settles lower, the flow smoothing out into calm, still water.
